info.description:
Reference schemas for webhook requests sent by Moloco Commerce Media (MCM).

Each delivery is an HTTP `POST` to the HTTPS endpoint configured for the
platform. Verify the signature against the raw request body, then use
`x-moloco-webhook-id` as the idempotency key before processing the event.
info.summary: Webhook events delivered by Moloco Commerce Media
info.title: MCM Webhooks

tags.description: Event payloads that MCM sends to registered webhook endpoints.
tags.name: Webhook Events

post.description:
Provides campaign recommendations for re-engaging churned ad accounts.
A delivery contains at most 20 ad accounts and at most 20 recommended
campaigns in total.

2XX.description: Return any 2xx status to acknowledge the delivery.

default.description: A non-2xx response is treated as a failed attempt and may be retried.

post.description:
Provides budget-increase recommendations for campaigns with high budget
utilization. A delivery can batch campaigns from up to 20 ad accounts.

2XX.description: Return any 2xx status to acknowledge the delivery.

default.description: A non-2xx response is treated as a failed attempt and may be retried.

WebhookId.description:
Idempotency key for the delivery. This value is identical to the body
`id`. Store processed IDs and ignore duplicate deliveries.
WebhookId.name: x-moloco-webhook-id

WebhookSignature.description:
Versioned HMAC signature for the raw request body. The value has the
form `t=<unix>,v1=<hex signature>`. During signing-key rotation, more
than one `v1` value can be present.

Compute `HMAC-SHA256(signing_secret, "{t}.{raw_request_body}")` and
compare its lowercase hexadecimal digest with a `v1` value. Do not
parse or re-serialize the body before verification.
WebhookSignature.name: x-moloco-webhook-signature

WebhookUserAgent.description: Identifies webhook requests sent by MCM.
WebhookUserAgent.name: User-Agent

AdAccountReEngageChurnedData.description: Campaign recommendations grouped by churned ad account.

campaign_count.description: Total number of recommended campaigns across all ad accounts.

ad_accounts.description:
Ad accounts in the delivery. Each ad account ID is unique. The
combined number of campaigns across this array does not exceed 20.

test.description: Whether the delivery was initiated as a test.

event_at.description: Time at which MCM created the webhook event, in RFC 3339 format.

platform_id.description: MCM platform that owns the webhook endpoint.

period.description: Period over which the budget can be consumed.

CampaignBudgetHighUpsellData.description: Budget recommendations grouped by ad account.

campaign_count.description: Total number of campaigns across all ad accounts.

ad_accounts.description: Ad accounts in the delivery. Each ad account ID is unique.

test.description: Whether the delivery was initiated as a test.

event_at.description: Time at which MCM created the webhook event, in RFC 3339 format.

platform_id.description: MCM platform that owns the webhook endpoint.

CampaignGoal.description:
Optimization goal for the recommended campaign. Exactly one setting
object is present, and it matches `type`.

campaigns.description: Recommended, not-yet-created campaigns for this ad account.

period.description: Budget period. Always `DAILY` for this event.

campaigns.description: Campaigns recommended for a budget increase. IDs are unique within the ad account.

recommended_budget.description: Recommended daily campaign budget. It is greater than `current_budget`.

current_budget.description: Current daily campaign budget, in the same currency as `recommended_budget`.

budget_utilization_pct.description: Current budget utilization in percent, for example `97`.

MaximizeSalesSetting.description: Empty settings object for the `MAXIMIZE_SALES` goal.

MoneyMicro.description:
A monetary amount in millionths of the currency unit. For example,
`1234` micro USD represents USD 0.001234. `amount_micro` is encoded as a
decimal string to preserve 64-bit integer precision.

amount_micro.description: Positive amount in micro units, encoded as a decimal string.

commission_rate.description: Target commission rate percentage, rounded to one decimal place.

target_roas.description: Target return on ad spend, in percent.

TimeInterval.description: Recommended campaign schedule in RFC 3339 format.

end.description: Campaign end time. Omitted for an open-ended campaign.

recommendation_id.description:
Recommendation ID. Pass this value when creating the recommended
campaign so its impact can be tracked. IDs are unique within the delivery.

catalog_item_ids.description:
Recommended catalog item IDs. This is an empty array for campaigns
that use smart selection without explicit item targets.

expires_at.description: Time at which the recommendation expires, in RFC 3339 format.

WebhookDeliveryId.description: A 16-character Base62 delivery identifier. It remains unchanged across automatic retries and manual resends.
